title: Notes to the Employer Statement: Payment Channels, Application Order and Credit Terms
content:
Payments on Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts are accepted by ACH debit, ACH credit, debit or credit card, and check. The same payment and credit terms apply in all seven financing classes.

| Financing class | Payment channels | Order for a payment not designated by quarter | Credit balance not claimed as a refund | Refund request limit (calendar months after the payment that created the credit) | Refund issued within (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Contributory — New Employer Standard Rate | ACH debit, ACH credit, debit or credit card, check | Oldest quarter first; then contribution, interest, penalty | Applied to the next quarter due | 36 | 15 |
| Contributory — New Employer Construction Rate | ACH debit, ACH credit, debit or credit card, check | Oldest quarter first; then contribution, interest, penalty | Applied to the next quarter due | 36 | 15 |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Positive Reserve | ACH debit, ACH credit, debit or credit card, check | Oldest quarter first; then contribution, interest, penalty | Applied to the next quarter due | 36 | 15 |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Deficit Reserve | ACH debit, ACH credit, debit or credit card, check | Oldest quarter first; then contribution, interest, penalty | Applied to the next quarter due | 36 | 15 |
| Contributory — Delinquent Reporting Assigned Rate | ACH debit, ACH credit, debit or credit card, check | Oldest quarter first; then contribution, interest, penalty | Applied to the next quarter due | 36 | 15 |
| Reimbursing — Nonprofit Organization | ACH debit, ACH credit, debit or credit card, check | Oldest quarter first; then contribution, interest, penalty | Applied to the next quarter due | 36 | 15 |
| Reimbursing — Governmental Entity | ACH debit, ACH credit, debit or credit card, check | Oldest quarter first; then contribution, interest, penalty | Applied to the next quarter due | 36 | 15 |

## Notes

1. **Payment channels.** The four channels listed are the channels through which payments are accepted.
2. **Application order.** A payment not designated by quarter goes to the oldest quarter with a balance first, and within a quarter to contribution, then interest, then penalty.
3. **Credit balance.** A credit balance not claimed as a refund is applied to the next quarter due.
4. **Refund request limit.** A refund must be requested within 36 calendar months after the payment that created the credit.
5. **Refund processing.** A refund is issued within 15 business days.

**Illustration of the application order (hypothetical account).** The oldest quarter with a balance owes USD 300.00 of contribution, USD 6.00 of interest and USD 50.00 of penalty, and a later quarter owes USD 400.00 of contribution. An undesignated payment of USD 330.00 settles the oldest quarter's contribution of USD 300.00, then its interest of USD 6.00, then USD 24.00 of its penalty; nothing reaches the later quarter.
